blocks.text: WAREHOUSE CLEANOUT FAQ
Warehouse Cleanout Services in Schomberg — FAQs

items.q: What does a warehouse cleanout in Schomberg actually cost?
a: Depends on the racking, what is on the shop floor, and how many outbuildings are in scope. We come and look, give you a number in writing, and that is the number. It does not move because the job ran longer than we expected.

items.q: Will you actually come out here, or is there a minimum on warehouse cleanout services?
a: No minimum, and no rural surcharge either. One building in Schomberg is a normal booking. That is the main reason people in the township call us rather than a contractor from Vaughan who prices the drive into every quote.

items.q: Do you charge extra for warehouse cleanout on a property out on the concessions?
a: No. A building on a concession road is priced the same as one on Highway 27. The drive affects our routing, not your invoice.

items.q: We're clearing a workshop with two barns and a yard behind it. Is that one warehouse cleanout?
a: Yes, quoted as one figure. On rural properties here the barns, drive sheds and yard routinely hold far more than the shop — parts, tooling, scrap steel, machinery nobody has run in years. That is exactly why we walk every building before quoting.

items.q: Can you clear a tack room, feed store or equipment barn as a warehouse cleanout?
a: Yes, and it comes up regularly given the horse belt through King Township. Bagged feed and bedding, tack and stable fittings, fencing, implements and scrap all get cleared the same way, at the same flat pricing as any other industrial job.
